id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the EmonTx hub.

*See also: [OpenEnergyMonitor EmonTx Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/emontx#configuration-variables)*

send_command.docs: Send a command string to the EmonTx device via UART. A newline character is appended automatically.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation or multiple hubs.

*See also: [OpenEnergyMonitor EmonTx Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/emontx#configuration-variables)*

on_data.docs:
An automation that will be triggered for every serial line received from the EmonTx (both plain text and JSON). Within this trigger, the `data` variable (string type) contains the received line. This is useful for debugging, logging all serial output, or handling configuration responses from the EmonTx.

*See also: [OpenEnergyMonitor EmonTx Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/emontx#configuration-variables)*

on_json.docs:
An automation that will be triggered whenever new JSON data is received from the EmonTx. Within this trigger, the `raw_json` variable (string type) contains the received JSON data as a string. A parsed JSON object is also available as the `json` variable (JsonObject type), which can be used to access and manipulate specific fields in the JSON data.

*See also: [OpenEnergyMonitor EmonTx Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/emontx#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [OpenEnergyMonitor EmonTx Sensors](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/emontx#configuration-variables)*
